status: experimental — declaration-only; observing, never enforcing (see www/policies/ai-use.adoc)

indexing.rationale: The site is published to be found; indexing public material crosses no boundary.

summarization.rationale: Mirrors ai.txt Disallow-Summarization: no — describing published material serves readers.

question_answering.rationale: Mirrors ai.txt: agents may read and analyse to assist contributors.

conditions: Embeddings may serve retrieval over the public material with attribution preserved.
Embedding corpora must not be redistributed or used as training input without explicit consent.
embedding.rationale: Retrieval aids discovery; corpus redistribution carries the licences (MPL-2.0 code, CC-BY-SA-4.0 docs).

training.rationale: Mirrors ai.txt Disallow-Training: yes — model training on this corpus requires explicit consent, which this declaration does not give.

fine_tuning.rationale: Fine-tuning is training with a narrower objective; the ai.txt stance applies unchanged.

commercial_training.rationale: As training, and additionally: contact the maintainer before any commercial incorporation — consent is explicit or it is absent.
commercial_training.alternatives: Cite the repository and its documentation instead of training on it.

generation.rationale: Mirrors ai.txt Disallow-Generation: yes — generated text must not be presented as this project's own statements.

enforcement.note: Declaration-only. HTTP 430 (draft-jewell-http-430-consent-required-00, EXPERIMENTAL) is the mechanism the draft defines for origins that can emit it; this template deliberately does not: minting or installing never enables 430. Enforcement would require a separate, explicit, versioned, provenance-bearing and independently testable profile choice, which this bundle does not ship.
enforcement.preferred_resolution: Correspondence and correction via the contact above.

metadata.author: Jonathan D.A. Jewell
related_standards: AIPREF (mapped alternative representation where they overlap)

philosophy.note: Purpose headers are unverified assertions; User-Agent inference is heuristic; unknown purpose remains unknown.
